report_topic: Performance Audit on Functioning of State Bank of Sikkim for the year ended March 2023
observations_summary: The audit found significant deficiencies in the functioning of the State Bank of Sikkim, including a high level of Gross Non-Performing Assets (52.23%), lack of regulatory oversight, non-formulation of critical policies, inadequate credit appraisal, and poor fraud risk management, leading to financial irregularities and potential losses.
